corpus.text: Self-attention has quadratic time and space complexity O(n^2) with respect to the sequence length n, creating a computational bottleneck when processing long document contexts.
Deep residual learning addresses the vanishing gradient degradation problem by introducing identity shortcut connections, allowing gradients to flow unimpeded through hundreds of layers.
Post-training quantization compresses large language models into 4-bit precision, substantially reducing GPU VRAM memory footprint while preserving task accuracy.
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) optimizes policy models directly from human preference data using an implicit reward formulation without training a separate reward model.
Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures route each input token to top-k selected expert sub-networks, dramatically expanding parameter capacity while maintaining constant FLOPs per token.
Diffusion probabilistic models learn the reverse Markovian trajectory to progressively remove Gaussian noise from degraded inputs to synthesize high-fidelity continuous data.
Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) freezes the pre-trained weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each transformer layer, reducing trainable parameters by over 99%.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language model generations in external authoritative passages, mitigating hallucinations and providing verifiable page-level provenance citations.
Relational databases utilize B-tree indexes and write-ahead logging to guarantee ACID transactions and fast relational query planning across normalized relational schemas.
Pair programming in agile software engineering pairs a driver and navigator at a single workstation to conduct continuous peer code review and collaborative problem solving.
